Hi Emma / Samir —

Hope you both had a smooth Thanksgiving week. As we approach your contract renewal window in mid-Jan, wanted to align on three quick items so we can avoid last-minute ops scrambling:

1) Runbook handoff: Monica has drafted a short ops runbook covering capacity uplift, fallback rules, and SSO provisioning for the new term. I attached the initial draft (storq-renewal-draft-terms-v1.pdf + capacity-mapping-2027.xlsx).

2) QBR timing & agenda: We propose a 60-min QBR in the first two weeks of Jan focused on (a) usage trends and cost levers, (b) capacity reservation options, (c) renewal terms & onboarding steps. Proposed agenda attached.

3) Stakeholder map & approvals: Can you confirm who from Storq will be the final sign-off for finance and security? We currently have Emma (Procurement) and Samir (Engineering) as primary but want to confirm CFO or legal reviewers.

Next steps:
- Emma/Samir: confirm approvers and availability windows by EOD Wed 12/2
- Monica: will share a compact ops runbook update by tomorrow with deployment timelines
- Marcus: will prepare a cost/throughput comparison across the four capacity tiers we discussed

If it helps, I can open a short calendar poll for Jan 5–12. Thanks — looking forward to smoothing this handoff.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Emma / Storq team —

I ran the throughput / cost sims for the uplift scenarios and attached the summary (capacity-mapping-2027.xlsx). Key points:

- 10% uplift: modest impact — latency within SLO, ~7% incremental monthly cost.
- 30% uplift: requires moving to the next capacity tier for sustained traffic; recommend reserved pool for the first 60 days to avoid preemption.
- Overage buffer: I support Monica's recommendation for a temporary 10% buffer for 30 days. We can include auto-fallback to a compat model (lower-cost quantized variant) if unexpected spikes occur.

Proposed QBR: Jan 6, 2027 09:00–10:30 PT (90 min) — covers: usage, uplift scenarios, runbook review, legal/finance timeline. I've added a calendar placeholder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=storq-qbr-poll

If that slot works, Laura / Dylan please lock and Monica will circulate the final runbook and SOW appendix.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
